item.title: Filing Income Tax for FY 2025-26: A Schedule-by-Schedule Breakdown of ITR-2
item.description: A line-by-line breakdown of filing ITR-2 for FY 2025-26 — backtracking every schedule from Salary (Sched S) to Other Sources (Sched OS), Capital Gains (Sched CG & 112A), Foreign Assets (Sched FA), Assets & Liabilities (Sched AL), and TCS tax credit setoff.
